feature_contract.goal: Restore native-aspect rendering of all originally rotated title/menu/car-selector D3DX sprites, including rotation-only calls without optional scale/translation vectors, while retaining the authored 2D pivot and the original gameplay, overlay and desktop fallback behavior.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact original title/menu/car-selection D3DXMatrixTransformation2D call path; only contained UI modes (OnlineArcade/KeepCentered); no gameplay ScreenHud, rank, GOAL/+TIME, lens, F11, input/FFB, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE or DXVK modification.
trace_stages: Original game title/menu/selector calls D3DXMatrixTransformation2D with optional scale/translation and independent rotation/rotation-center inputs.
D3DX writes a full native 2D affine matrix including its rotation/pivot before the hook applies min-axis 4:3 containment across both XY bases and translation.
Exact front-end state/mode limits prevent transformation of unrelated HUD and world draw owners.
subcomponents: Accept valid rotation-only D3DX calls in the existing post-composition path without manufacturing optional scale/translation arguments.
Keep mixed scale/translation, pivoted sprites, native 4:3, vanilla and non-front-end input fallbacks intact; test the admission matrix with compile-time positive/negative cases.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Title, menu and vehicle-selection rotated affine sprites
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A rotation-only D3DX call with both optional vectors absent uses full affine min-axis containment with the original rotation and pivot, preserving art proportions on 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 and portrait targets.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Nullable D3DX vectors and original gameplay/vanilla/identity owners
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Rotated/pivoted scaling and translation retain the old path; no-op centres, non-front-end gameplay ScreenHud/GOAL/+TIME/F11 and vanilla mode do not gain a new transform; reset/invalid matrix retains original.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 x86 game plus host/package, Domain and affected source gates
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Mandatory DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact and HUD Inspector checks are successful on one exact final source SHA.

diagnosis.root_cause: The menu full-affine path was gated on (pScaling || pTranslation) even though both D3DX inputs are optional and an independently supplied rotation can yield a non-identity matrix; the rotation-only matrix bypassed aspect-preserving post-composition.
alternatives_rejected: Do not change the unrelated R84 world stereo or host menu capture/crop: the fault is in the exact 2D producer admission.
Do not fill missing D3DX inputs with invented vectors: post-compose the original D3DX matrix to preserve pivots and rotation.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Source-built constexpr input-ownership regressions for rotation-only, pivoted scale, translation, no-op centres, gameplay and vanilla, plus unchanged full 2D matrix composition.

runtime_evidence: Quest3/VDXR run not performed; no claim of fixed optical menu in real hardware.
